input.summary: Insert an intellectual property section giving the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site and other deliverables, while HDI keeps its generic tools and know-how, and limiting HDI's licence in Company data to providing the Services.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement allocates no intellectual property rights, so we have added a short IP section: HDI keeps its generic tools and know-how, we receive a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site and other deliverables for our business, and HDI's licence in our Content and data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services. This is our fallback position.

ops.text: Intellectual Property. HDI retains ownership of its generic tools and know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense the Site and any other deliverables developed for the Company under this Agreement for its business. Any license granted to HDI in the Content or other data belonging to, supplied by or processed for the Company is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services under this Agreement.
